reason: Seeing the drawer cash and who is in the chair while I'm at my other work is tempting, but for a one-or-two-chair shop, ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month is too much fixed cost when some months are slow. My one boy can WhatsApp me a photo of the register for free.
objection: ₹999 a month is one more fixed cost, and some months are slow. With only one or two staff I can't see it saving me ₹12,000 a year, and I'm not sure my staff will bother typing every bill into an English app when I'm not there.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and around ₹399-499 a month, or a cheaper plan for 1-2 chair shops, plus proof from another small barber nearby that it actually caught missing cash.
